question: What has been declared regarding the adoption of renunciation in the Kali age?
premises: It is declared in relation to the Kali age.
inference: The adoption of renunciation in the Kali age has been declared as such.
uncertainties: The evaluative force of the declaration depends on the immediately preceding verses.
plain_english: O dear one, that indeed has been declared as the adoption of renunciation in the Kali age.
